title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ID
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ID . A unique identifier. s4inma:ID is a subclass of skos:ConceptScheme and the root of the SAREF4INMA identifier hierarchy; GTIN8ID, GTIN12ID, GTIN13ID, GTIN14ID, IRDI and UUID are its concrete subclasses, each adding its own more specific identifier-value property (documented on each of those models) instead of repeating hasIDValue.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ID'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasIDValue.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasIDValue'. The value of the identifier expressed as a string (used as an alternative to, or in combination with, the hasIdentifier relationship linking an entity to its ID).
